title: Demotic Magical Papyrus of London and Leiden (PDM xiv) / Лондонско-Лейденский демотический магический папирус
author: Anonymous (Theban magical library)
language: Demotic, with Old Coptic glosses and Greek
edition: Griffith & Thompson (1904–09; public domain, archive.org: facsimile, transliteration, English); Betz, Greek Magical Papyri in Translation (1986).
ru_evidence: CyberLeninka ('Лейденский магический папирус демотический') finds no translation; none found.
value: A bridge between Egyptian ritual and the Greek Magical Papyri (same Theban library). Vital for religion in Roman Egypt, Old Coptic and Greek–Egyptian bilingualism.
ai_feasibility: medium: a public-domain transliteration exists, so the source can be published freely; voces magicae and Old Coptic glosses are tricky.
pilot_unit: Lamp and vessel divination spells (first c. 5 columns)
